name: Viridescent Dragon: Chapter 2
source:
After meeting with Doctor Adam Cendrillon, Charlotte and Seleste head off to do a task to retrieve a rare plant with magical healing properties with a mysterious new ally: Dawn Ngo. With the Violean Royal Guard on their tails, how will they fare in the face of even more threats? Aye, the sea is a very dangerous place...

This is the second of many humorous and drama-filled chapters to come. As a warning this game at the most has some foul language, a bit of blood, mild sexual themes and crude humor.
translation:
与亚当·灰姑娘医生会面后，夏洛特和塞莱斯特与神秘的新盟友道恩·恩戈一起前往执行一项任务，取回一种具有神奇治疗功效的稀有植物。紫罗兰皇家卫队紧随其后，面对更多威胁，他们将如何应对？是的，大海是一个非常危险的地方……

这是接下来许多幽默且充满戏剧性的章节中的第二章。警告一下，这款游戏至多有一些粗言秽语、一点血腥、温和的性主题和粗俗的幽默。
